function.name: book_appointment
function.description: Book an arrival window. ONLY call after reading back name, address, day/window and problem and hearing the caller say yes; then set caller_confirmed to true. Pass customer_id and address_id from lookup_customer when the caller confirmed them; otherwise pass address. Returns booked:true, or ok:false with reason slot_taken and alternatives.

slot_id.description: slot_id of the window the caller chose.

caller_confirmed.description: Must be true: the caller confirmed the read-back.

customer_id.description: From lookup_customer, if found and confirmed.

phone.description: Best callback number if different from caller ID.

address_id.description: address_id from lookup_customer when using an address on file.

line1.description: House number and street, e.g. 37-12 82nd St.

zip.description: 5-digit ZIP code of the service address, e.g. 11372.

service_type.description: maintenance = tune-up; repair = known problem; diagnostic = unknown cause.

urgency.description: From triage: book_earliest = urgent, book_standard = routine.

issue_summary.description: One-sentence description of the problem in the caller's words.

symptoms.description: Specific symptoms, e.g. 'blowing cold air', 'clicking noise'.

equipment.description: Equipment involved, if known: type, brand, age.

vulnerable_occupants.description: Vulnerable people in the home. Empty array if none.

messages.content: One moment while I book that.
